name: workbuddy2api-pages
description: workbuddy2api 网关：Go 后端云原生重写为 Cloudflare Pages (Pages Functions + Durable Objects)。前端静态资源与后端 API 全部由 Pages 托管。

scripts.build: node scripts/gen-commit.mjs && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=dist/_worker.js --platform=browser --target=es2022 --define:process.env.NODE_ENV='"production"' && npm run copy-frontend
scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler pages dev dist --binding WB2A_API_KEY=dev-admin-key --kv WB2A_CONFIG --kv WB2A_CACHE --d1 WB2A_DB --r2 WB2A_LOGS --do POOL=PoolDO@workbuddy2api-engine
scripts.deploy:engine: npm run build:engine && wrangler deploy --config engine-worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.dev:engine: npm run build:engine && wrangler dev --config engine-worker/wrangler.toml --port 8787 --test-scheduled
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist
